hooks.command: bash -c 'input=$(cat); sid=$(printf %s "$input" | python3 -I -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"session_id\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || printf %s "$input" | jq -r ".session_id // \"\"" 2>/dev/null); [ -n "${CLAUDE_ENV_FILE:-}" ] || exit 0; [ -n "$sid" ] && echo "export AGENTLOCK_OWNER=$sid" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; echo "export PATH=\"${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts:\$PATH\"" >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"; exit 0'

bash -c 'input=$(cat); sid=$(printf %s "$input" | python3 -I -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"session_id\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null || printf %s "$input" | jq -r ".session_id // \"\"" 2>/dev/null); AGENTLOCK_OWNER=$sid "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"/scripts/agentlock release-all >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0'
